The spirit of philoxenia

Good company.
A generous table.
A very Greek welcome.

The conversations needn’t end when the meetings do. A welcome cocktail on Thursday and dinner with accompanying guests on Friday make room for the other great tradition of the weekend: enjoying each other’s company.

Leave room in your suitcase.
You’ll be taking home new friendships.

Beyond the meetings

Athens is part of the invitation.

A dedicated accompanying guests’ programme brings the city into the weekend. These activities are proposed in the preliminary programme.

A little wandering. A lot to discover.

Friday’s proposed programme combines a walk through historic central Athens with an afternoon wellness visit. Meeting points and arrangements to follow.

Make time for the city.

Saturday’s proposed guests’ visit takes in the Stavros Niarchos Foundation Cultural Centre. The afternoon is free for your own discoveries, a leisurely coffee or another conversation.
